  • Support the broader growth surface: events, partnerships, content, and marketing

What we look for:

  • 2+ years in investor relations / finance, MBB, or a commercial/operational role at a fast-paced startup

  • Experience in private markets, particularly around investor relations workflows, is a strong plus

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship building skills, as well as analytical instincts

  • Genuine tolerance for repetition and rejection - this is some of the highest impact work you can do for the company, but it’s also high volume and requires scrappiness

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills when interfacing with clients who have a very high standard for output and attention to detail

  • Creativity and a bias to action, particularly when supporting with broader growth/marketing topics

Why join us?

jobs.description:
Strategy & Operations (1-3 YoE)

London, 4x days per week in-office

Vega is looking for multi-disciplinary A players who have what it takes to build a business from the ground up. We hire people who are already high-performers in MBB or finance/investing, but still have the itch to do more. This role will sit in the CEO Office, reporting to the Head of Strategy & Growth, working across the highest strategic priorities in the business.

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by Alexis Augier, a former investor at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo (who were a client before becoming an investor), Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

In this role, you will:

  • Context-switch across strategy, go-to-market, operations, external comms, special projects, and investor relations

  • Be handed projects from Day 1, including representing Vega externally

  • Sit in the CEO Office, reporting directly to the Head of Strategy & Growth

  • Work closely with the Product & Growth and Engineering teams - strategy is not a silo at Vega

What we look for:

  • Required: 1-3 years of experience in MBB or finance/investing at a Tier 1 institution.

  • Whilst stellar training is essential, this is not all that we look for and not everyone with a background in MBB/investing will do well. This role is for people who have high standards of excellence for themselves, along with the risk tolerance and ambition to go beyond the comfort zone and structure of a larger institution.

  • Low ego, and a willingness to get stuck in; this role will allow you to do career-accelerating things that you might otherwise wait decades to do - but there will also be gruntwork. Everyone at Vega, including leadership, handles both.

  • Exceptional analytical and communication skills. You will need to think and explain complex concepts and communicate them internally and externally with different audiences.

Why join us?

  • Get a first-hand view, and real ownership of, everything that it takes to operate a fast-growing business

  • You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

jobs.excerpt: Twin Health At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care.
jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

Join us in one of our most critical member-facing roles, inspiring behavior change and motivating members to adopt new behaviors and improve their health. As a Twin Health Coach, you make a difference in people's lives every day by providing guidance, support, education, and encouragement to empower your members seeking to prevent and reverse chronic metabolic diseases and improve their overall health.

This is a data- and AI-driven coaching model, not an independent private-practice style of coaching. Your day-to-day priorities, member outreach, and session focus are generated by the Twin platform from continuous data streams — CGM, weight, sleep, movement, and app engagement — and your role is to interpret those insights and deliver them with empathy and motivational skill, not to build an independent care plan from scratch. You'll follow standardized SOPs and escalation pathways, lean on nurses, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants for clinical needs, and work within structured, time-boxed sessions rather than open-ended ones.

This role is a great fit if you naturally help people take on difficult things, understand that habit change is hard, and are skilled in behavioral tools that activate people to change — and if you also genuinely enjoy working inside a structured, metrics-driven, technology-forward environment where the coaching model, caseload, and tools are standardized and evolve quickly as we scale.

This role is not a fit if you're looking for the autonomy of independent or contract coaching — self-set hours, a capped or self-managed caseload, or full latitude to design your own coaching approach. It's built for coaches who want structure and a technology-integrated practice.

The schedule for this position is Monday - Friday, some evenings. This is a W-2, employee-model role with a fixed schedule and team coverage obligations.

A Day in the Life

  • Back-to-back 15- and 30-minute video coaching sessions across a high-volume, uncapped caseload
  • Reviewing AI-surfaced member data (glucose trends, weight, sleep, engagement) before and during sessions to guide the conversation
  • Daily AI-assisted member rounding between scheduled visits, plus progress notes and chats completed within 24 business hours
  • Following SOPs for coaching structure, documentation, and escalation — with limited discretion to deviate from the standardized model
  • Adapting to frequent changes in tools, protocols, and schedules as Twin scales

Responsibilities

  • Onboard, activate, and manage members as part of a seamless coaching experience
  • Conduct 15-minute and 30-minute virtual coaching sessions via video or phone to engage members in setting goals, managing their care, and staying motivated on their journey to self-efficacy — completing the full arc of education, motivation, and data review within these time-boxed windows
  • Motivate, coach, and provide exceptional service and support to members to achieve health goals as designated by the Twin app
  • Provide general education on healthy eating principles, meal planning basics, and lifestyle strategies — without crossing into Medical Nutrition Therapy or individualized therapeutic nutrition
  • Use AI-powered tools and other resources as the primary basis for member support, metrics-driven insights, and coaching direction
  • Use AI-powered tools to support daily member rounding in addition to scheduled visits, and complete progress notes and chats within 24 business hours
  • Provide feedback on member metrics including weight, continuous glucose monitoring, sleep, movement, adherence to nutrition guidance, and app engagement, identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Strictly adhere to Standard Operating Procedures for member management, session structure, and escalations.
  • Collaborate closely with coaching team colleagues, providers, registered nurses, and operations teams to drive a seamless member experience
  • Participate in ongoing pilot programs and support additional programs as needed, including new tools or workflow changes
  • Participate in collecting member testimonials to support partner success needs
  • Act as a team player, providing coverage for weekend and holiday on-call responsibilities (approximately 2–4x per year) and unplanned PTO visit coverage
  • Maintain a high-volume, uncapped caseload that will fluctuate based on business needs
  • Maintain flexibility to work any shift (at least 2 evening shifts per week) or change shifts based on business needs
  • Complete additional duties as assigned
  • Maintain a HIPAA-compliant remote work environment and reliable internet connectivity sufficient to conduct uninterrupted video-based member visits

Productivity

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment with competing priorities
  • Demonstrate strong time management, staying within allotted session lengths rather than routinely extending visits
  • Consistently meet or exceed productivity and quality benchmarks, including session-time adherence
  • Work autonomously within your day-to-day tasks while remaining fully aligned with team goals, SOPs, and operational standards
  • Adapt quickly to evolving tools, processes, and business needs

Communication

  • Clear, confident communicator across member and internal interactions
  • Strong team player who collaborates effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to deliver clear, concise communication
  • Ability to balance efficiency with empathy in every interaction, including within time-boxed sessions
  • Skilled in de-escalation and handling challenging conversations with professionalism
  • Communicate effectively across multiple channels (phone, video, chat, email)
  • Provide clear insights and updates to team members, leadership, and cross-functional partners

Human-Centered Service & Hospitality

Job Summary

Strategic Communications Manager

Job Summary

Aptive is seeking a full-time Communications Manager to lead a wide range of executive outreach efforts and to manage and develop a team of communications professionals. In addition to producing executive-level communications products directly, this role sets standards for the team's work, assigns and balances workload against deadlines, reviews and approves deliverables before they reach senior leaders, and serves as the primary communications point of contact for client leadership.

This is a full-time remote position.

  • Lead, supervise, and develop a team of communications specialists, including assigning work, setting priorities, balancing workload against competing deadlines, and managing team capacity.

  • Engage and identify targeted stakeholders to create and demonstrate implementation of decisions for executive communications.
  • Establish and maintain communication channels that facilitate engagement between VHA Central Office, VISNs, and VA Medical Centers.

  • Demonstrated ability to give direct, constructive feedback and grow the capability of a team.
  • Experience supporting VA, VHA, or other federal health communications, including change management and field-facing messaging.
  • Familiarity with change management methodology such as PROSCI, and with Section 508 accessibility requirements for published content.

Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive.

Your mandate includes retention, expansion, and upsell. This VP will lead three distinct functions, unified under one CX operating model:

  • Onboarding & Implementation: End-to-end client onboarding from contract close through go-live. Refine our segmented approach that delivers high-touch, white-glove onboarding for enterprise clients while deploying scalable, automation-enabled processes and one-to-many resources for smaller clients.   • Customer Success: Oversight of retention, NDR, and lifetime value optimization. Instrument the function with data and AI to proactively identify churn risk and expansion signals in real time, freeing your team to focus on high-impact conversations.   • Technical Support: Ticket resolution, escalations, knowledge management, and SLA compliance. Unification & Operational Design

AI & Automation as Operating System

Ema is building the world’s first Universal AI Employee — a production-grade agentic AI platform that automates real enterprise workflows across HR, IT, Finance, and Operations.

  • AI behavior

  • Workflow orchestration

  • Enterprise integrations

  • Customer trust

  • Engineering feedback loops

Impact at Ema

  • You are the last line of defense between a production issue and customer trust erosion

  • You prevent small failures from turning into account-level crises

  • You ensure learnings from incidents improve the product and delivery systemically

Impact on Customers

  • Customers trust Ema because issues are handled competently and transparently

  • AI failures are explained, mitigated, and prevented — not hand-waved

  • Production stability improves over time, not degrades

  • You gain rare experience operating agentic AI systems in production

    • AI behavior (false positives / negatives)

    • Workflow logic

    • Integrations (HRIS, ITSM, IAM, Finance)

    • Data quality

    • Platform configuration

  • Handling Sev-1 / Sev-2 customer specific incidents calmly under customer pressure

  • Help Engineering & Product teams Prevent repeated incidents through disciplined RCA

  • Converting noisy customer complaints into high-signal engineering feedback

  • Own customer-reported issues from intake to resolution adhering strictly to SLAs

  • Take responsibility for diagnosis, coordination, and closure; Importantly, provide workarounds to customers to unblock them while engineering fix is made

  • Ensure no issue is “lost” between teams

  • Act as technical owner even when multiple teams are involved

5.2 Debugging, Diagnosis & Sev 1/2 Issue Resolution

  • Debug agentic workflows end-to-end

  • Trace failures across agents, tools, integrations, and humans-in-the-loop

  • Identify whether issues are caused by:

    • Model behavior

    • Prompt / policy logic

    • Workflow orchestration

    • Integration constraints

    • Customer configuration

  • Provide clear, actionable root cause summaries

  • Resolve Sev 1 / Sev 2 Client issues; Escalate to the right team to help solve and close the issue. Keep customer communication calm, factual, and confidence-building

5.4 Customer Communication & Trust

  • Communicate during incidents without speculation or panic

  • Explain AI failures in a way customers can understand

  • Set realistic recovery timelines

  • Rebuild trust post-incident through transparency and follow-through

5.6 Feedback Loops to Engineering & Product

  • Write high-signal bug reports and incident summaries

  • Advocate for fixes based on customer impact, not noise

  • Help Product understand real production behavior

  • Ensure support insights influence roadmap and quality improvement

5.7 Support Operations & Excellence

  • Improve runbooks, playbooks, and diagnostics

  • Improve on-call hygiene and escalation clarity

  • Mentor junior support engineers

  • Raise the overall support bar at Ema

6. Traits We’re Looking For

Technical & Diagnostic Strength

  • Excellent debugging instincts

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous systems

  • Able to isolate root cause across layers

Ownership & Reliability Mindset

  • Issues do not bounce — they get owned

  • Calm during incidents

  • Bias toward permanent fixes

Judgment & Communication

  • Knows when to escalate and when not to

  • Can say “we don’t know yet” credibly

  • Communicates clearly with both engineers and customers

Cultural Fit

  • Low ego, high accountability

  • Truth-seeking over blame

  • Respects both customer urgency and engineering quality

7. Required Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS platforms in production

  • Strong understanding of:

    • APIs and integrations

    • Distributed systems

    • Logs, traces, and diagnostics

8. Preferred Background

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.


The Role

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Executive to support hiring across multiple functions and regions as BJAK continues to scale globally.

This is a hands-on recruitment role for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple hiring priorities, and partnering closely with stakeholders to deliver hiring outcomes. You will have exposure to a wide range of functions including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, and other business-critical teams.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for assigned roles across multiple functions and locations.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, candidate profiles, and business priorities.

  • Source, screen, assess, and engage candidates through various channels including LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, job boards, and direct outreach.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for both active and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping and market research to support hiring strategies.

  • Coordinate and manage interview processes while ensuring a positive candidate experience.

  • Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment activities within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

  • Provide regular hiring updates and pipeline insights to hiring managers and stakeholders.

  • Support recruitment process improvements, hiring initiatives, and employer branding activities where required.

  • Collaborate with recruiters, coordinators, and business leaders to achieve hiring goals across the organization.


The Right Fit Has

  • 2–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, Executive Search, Staffing, or a related field.

  • Proven experience managing multiple vacancies simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong sourcing capabilities across LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, networking, and direct outreach.

  • Experience recruiting across multiple functions such as Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, or other corporate functions.

  • Strong candidate assessment and interviewing skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and execution.

  • Comfortable operating in an environment with evolving priorities and ambitious hiring goals.

  • Demonstrates ownership, resilience, adaptability, and a proactive mindset.

  • Experience in technology companies, startups, recruitment agencies, or high-growth organizations is highly preferred.

  • Fluency in English is required. Additional language capabilities such as Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, or Japanese are an advantage.


What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers strong candidate pipelines across multiple functions and markets.

  • Consistently achieves hiring targets while maintaining quality and candidate experience.

  • Builds trusted relationships with hiring managers and stakeholders.

  • Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability throughout the recruitment process.

  • Contributes to improving recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and overall team performance.


Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and development opportunities.

  • Exposure to international hiring across multiple markets and functions.

  • Opportunity to work directly with experienced recruiters and business leaders.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and responsibility from day one.

  • Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.

  • Meaningful work that directly contributes to the growth and success of the business.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

jobs.description:
About Kojo

It's time to build. Whether it's creating more housing, upgrading our infrastructure, or adapting to climate change, one thing is clear: the construction industry is at the center of solving our biggest problems. We’re making buildings cheaper and easier to build by transforming the way commercial construction companies buy their materials. Join us.

Founded in 2018, Kojo is now one of the fastest-growing construction technology companies in the world. Construction accounts for $10 trillion in global spend annually and we can’t live without its output - our roads, schools, hospitals, and offices. Despite this, there’s been very little innovation over the past 70 years in how materials - which constitute up to 40% of project costs - are bought and sold. This is our opportunity.

About the Role

To meet our season of record-breaking customer growth and AI product innovation, we’re bringing on a Recruiting Lead to own the recruiting function end to end. Primarily in the GTM/G&A realms, entry-level to senior leadership searches will fall under this recruiter’s purview - plus the recruiting operations that keep the machine running behind the scenes.

In a talent landscape that’s ever-evolving and increasingly competitive, a best in class recruiting function is more important than ever. Our hiring methodology isn’t sheer volume, but sincere business partnership and quality of hire. You’ll work with hiring managers as an extension of their team and manage the operations and scalability to maintain best in class hiring amid global expansion. As a Series C company growing at this record-breaking pace, every hire you make has an outsized impact on what Kojo becomes next. There's no more pivotal time to join and help us take Kojo further into the candidate market.

What you'll own:

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Kojo's GTM and G&A searches, from intake to offer, across levels from entry-level to senior leadership.

  • Actively source best-in-class candidates, both active and passive, and ensure a white glove candidate experience through consultative, timely communication and market intelligence to properly matchmake between open roles at Kojo.

  • Manage, iterate, and continue to run the operating rhythm behind recruiting: profile debriefs and ICP iterations, pipeline reviews, and the reporting cadence that keeps hiring managers and leadership aligned on where every search stands.

  • Manage Ashby as Kojo's ATS and single source of truth for headcount budgeting, owning requisition workflows, scorecards, and the data hygiene that makes every pipeline report trustworthy.

  • Own compensation benchmarking for open reqs, partnering with our Director of People on real-time GTM and G&A market data instead of last year's numbers.

  • Continuously close candidates through every stage in the hiring process to ensure a best in class offer acceptance rate, and manage the offer for every close, partnering directly with Finance on budget and approval before it goes out.

  • Diagnose where the recruiting process itself is the bottleneck, time-to-fill, drop-off stage, interviewer load, and fix it before it becomes a leadership question.

  • Leverage AI-enabled workflows and internal tools (e.g., Claude, Granola, Notion, LinkedIn Recruiter) to understand market signals at scale by synthesizing feedback, hiring patterns, and requests to identify opportunities before they become obvious.

About You

We’re looking for the recruiter who treats every search as the chance to bring exceptional talent and outsized impact to Kojo. Our ideal Lead Recruiter is a student of the market: constantly building a genuine knowledge base of the ever-changing talent landscape in AI and construction, and knowing where the best talent sits today and what it takes to get them excited about Kojo.

Early stage experience is strongly preferred in this environment. Priorities shift, searches evolve, and there’s a sincere opportunity to scale far beyond the bounds of this job description. We’re looking for someone who wants to build with the company and may be operating as an individual contributor today, but has the curiosity to scale into broader leadership roles as we continue to grow.

What we're looking for:

  • Full-cycle ownership: You've run searches start to finish, from intake call to signed offer (and hopefully hiring high-slope talent where those candidates become long-term employees), without needing a coordinator to hold your hand through any stage.

  • GTM fluency: You know the difference between what makes a great SDR and what makes a great enterprise AE, and you screen for it accordingly (deep GTM specialization is ideal, not required for every search).

  • Early-stage instinct: "You've recruited inside a company early enough in its growth that you were also inventing and iterating upon the process, not just following one.

  • Ops discipline: You treat your ATS as a system of record and have demonstrated experience trusting that data and partnering with Operations and Finance stakeholders to allow your data to inform business decisions.

  • Independent operation: You have strong judgement to know what’s urgent, what’s important, and where your time and energy should go in order to best serve the business in real time. You have experience pattern matching not only with candidate themes, but consistently upleveling the internal recruiting function from the inside out.

  • AI-literate sourcing: You've used AI tools to speed up sourcing or screening, and you can point to a specific moment you overrode the tool's judgment with your own.

  • Range across levels: You've closed both an entry-level hire and a senior leadership hire in the same quarter, and you didn't treat either one as the easy one.

What you care about:

  • ACCOUNTABILITY: You own the calibration call between a hiring manager who wants faster and a comp band that isn't moving, and you make the trade-off explicit instead of quietly splitting the difference.

  • IMPACT: You're running searches at three different levels at once, and you always know which one earns the next hour of your day.

  • GROWTH: You read the market data before you defend a comp number, not after a candidate pushes back on it.

Working at Kojo

Salary: Your salary will be dependent upon many factors, including your experience level, skillset, market dynamics and balancing internal equity relative to other Kojo employees. The compensation and benefits information that we provide is based on Kojo’s good-faith estimate as of the date of the job posting and may be modified in the future.

Benefits: This position is also eligible for a new hire equity grant and all US-based full time employees are eligible for our full suite of perks and benefits. For more information about our perks and benefits, check out

Location: Kojo’s team members work from home 100% of the time across North and South America. If applicable, we’ll identify the travel and/or location-specific requirements of a position in the text above. Otherwise, team members can expect to work business hours congruent with their local time zone and remotely.

Inclusive Workplace: Kojo values diverse perspectives and is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, citizenship, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.



Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of Kojo. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Kojo will never ask for any personal account information, such credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process.

jobs.excerpt: Our Commitment to Our TeamAt Pipe17, our values aren’t just words on a wall.
jobs.description:
Our Commitment to Our Team

At Pipe17, our values aren’t just words on a wall. They’re how we operate every day.

We are a high-performance team built around ownership, urgency, curiosity, and a strong bias for action.

We set bold goals, hold ourselves accountable, and move fast to solve customer problems. Every team member owns their decisions and drives outcomes. No one waits for permission.

We operate with urgency, but not recklessly. We focus on what matters most, take initiative, and course-correct quickly when needed. We value people who speak up, follow through, and take pride in their work.

Curiosity is how we get better. We ask questions, challenge assumptions, and stay open to new ideas. We don’t default to “how it’s always been done.” We explore, test, and learn. That mindset helps us adapt quickly, solve harder problems, and continuously raise the bar.

We also embrace AI as a force multiplier. We believe great operators don’t compete with AI - they partner with it. We use AI to move faster, think deeper, and remove friction from our work, while still applying human juådgåment, creativity, and context where it matters most. Thoughtful use of AI is part of how we scale ourselves and our impact.

Finally, teamwork is at our core. We win together, support each other, and celebrate our shared victories. Collaboration across functions is a daily practice, not just something we talk about. We learn from each other, improve constantly, and rally around our mission: unify commerce after the buy button.

If these values resonate with how you like to work, you’ll fit right in.

About the Role

We are hiring a Customer Success Manager in LATAM to own a portfolio of customers end-to-end, including retention, renewals, account growth, and day-to-day customer management. This person will serve as the primary post-sale point of contact, ensuring customers are supported, successful, and consistently seeing value.

This role blends commercial ownership across renewals and expansion with hands-on customer success execution, including enablement, adoption, issue triage, and relationship management. The ideal candidate has strong commerce and operations understanding and can credibly work with teams across ecommerce operations, finance, and systems.

What You’ll Do

Own retention and renewals

  • Lead renewal timelines and renewal conversations, ensuring on-time execution
  • Maintain accurate renewal forecasts and risk tracking across your book of business
  • Identify churn risk early and coordinate mitigation plans across internal teams

Drive expansion revenue

  • Identify and execute expansion opportunities such as additional channels, volume tiers, new workflows, and multi-year agreements
  • Lead QBRs and account planning sessions tied to customer goals and outcomes
  • Build close plans and coordinate internal resources to support upsell and cross-sell motions

Own the customer relationship

  • Act as the main customer point of contact and manage communication, expectations, and timelines
  • Guide onboarding and ongoing enablement, especially around workflows and operational change
  • Ensure customers adopt the product and realize measurable business outcomes
  • Create clear success plans tied to how ecommerce teams operate and scale

Commerce-aware support and escalation management

  • Triage customer issues and coordinate with Support, Product, and Engineering to drive resolution
  • Own customer communication during escalations with clear status updates and expectation-setting
  • Bring structure to customer pain points by identifying root causes and preventing repeat issues

Operate your book of business

  • Keep CRM data clean, including account notes, renewal dates, customer health, stakeholders, and activity
  • Build lightweight reporting on retention, expansion pipeline, risks, and account sentiment
  • Improve the post-sale motion by creating reusable templates, playbooks, and workflows

Commerce Expertise We’re Looking For

You do not need to have been an operator, but you should understand:

  • Ecommerce order-to-cash basics, including orders, payments, refunds, tax, and settlement
  • Fulfillment and logistics fundamentals, including 3PLs, warehouses, shipping SLAs, and exceptions
  • Inventory and returns workflows, including RMAs, restocking, and exchanges
  • Channel ecosystem knowledge across Shopify, Amazon, marketplaces, retail, and EDI
  • What breaks operationally when brands scale fast or add new channels

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, you will:

  • Build strong relationships quickly and become the trusted owner for key accounts
  • Establish renewal rigor through timelines, forecasting, risk tracking, and execution
  • Improve customer experience through faster response, clearer ownership, and better follow-through
  • Proactively surface growth opportunities based on customer commerce goals and pain points
  • Reduce reactive fire drills by creating structure around recurring issues

Qualifications

Must-have

  • 3 to 8 years experience owning a book of business in Account Management, Customer Success, or post-sale ownership roles
  • Strong customer-facing skills including structured communication and credibility with stakeholders
  • Communications playbook for onboarding, account management and renewals/upsells
  • Comfort owning revenue outcomes including renewals, negotiation, and expansion motions
  • Commerce fluency and understanding of ecommerce operations and systems
  • Strong organization and execution skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts effectively
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills

Nice-to-have

  • Experience working with ecommerce brands, 3PLs, OMS or WMS tools, marketplaces, or integrations
  • Familiarity with platforms like Shopify, NetSuite, and Amazon
  • Experience in B2B SaaS with operational workflows and complex implementations
  • Experience handling escalations and translating between customers and technical teams

Traits That Win in This Role

  • Revenue and retention mindset with strong ownership
  • Commerce-first problem solving and the ability to speak the customer’s language
  • Calm and clear communication under pressure
  • Strong follow-through and accountability
  • Proactive instincts that surface risk early and drive resolution

Compensation (US FTE)

  • Competitive salary
  • Great healthcare + dental + vision coverage
  • Retirement plan
  • Pick your own equipment. We'll set you up with whatever Apple laptop + monitor combo you want plus any software you need.
  • Unlimited vacation policy. Plus we require you to take at least 2 weeks off each year. We see most employees take 4 weeks off per year. This isn't a vague policy where unlimited vacation means no vacation

About Us

Pipe17 is the AI-native Enterprise Order Operations Platform for brands and 3PLs. We replace the fragmented stack of iPaaS, middleware, and legacy OMS with one unified operational layer that manages orders, inventory, products, fulfillment, and exceptions across every channel and partner.

With 300+ managed connectors, AI-powered workflows, and an industry-first MCP Server for agentic commerce, Pipe17 lets brands go live in weeks, scale into new channels in days, and run post-checkout operations without developer dependency or systems integrators.

Our customers reduce operational costs by up to 85%, cut fulfillment errors by 99%, and launch new channels in days instead of months. Pipe17 is trusted by enterprise brands including Estée Lauder, Allbirds, e.l.f. Beauty, Made In Cookware, Wyze, Olly, Black Rifle Coffee Company, and Dude Wipes, as well as leading 3PLs including Ryder, FedEx, and Barrett Distribution.

Pipe17 is a venture-funded software company headquartered in Seattle, WA with a significant presence in the San Francisco Bay Area. The company is backed by GLP Capital Partners, a leading investor in ecommerce logistics, and recently announced its Series A funding to accelerate growth and category leadership.

We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. As our first Corporate Development hire, you will work directly with the founding team to shape how Menlo grows -- through capital, partnerships, and strategic deals. What You Will Bring

PartsBase offers a FULLY remote environment where one can work at the forefront of where the aviation business meets technology. Imagine getting to work with peers worldwide, implementing business technology projects that challenge the boundaries.

Our inclusive culture welcomes all employees and values their unique contributions to our success. Our clients tell us time and time again that our people set us apart from the competition. They will act as an influencer and expert resource for customers and others to ensure success while enabling sales growth through strategic activities and creative problem solving. The Informatics Sales Specialist should be viewed as a “go to” subject matter expert for all things Informatics, with primary focus on Illumina’s clinical software products.

As an Informatics Sales Specialist, you are impacting clinical data analysis and interpretation through effective engagement with C-level executives, Laboratory Directors, Healthcare practitioners, IT leaders, and data analysts. You are establishing Illumina as a prominent cloud-based enterprise platform provider to the Clinical, Pharma, and Healthcare sectors.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Drive clinical customer adoption and utilization and thus sales growth, of our Informatics products by:
  • Providing technical guidance and subject matter expertise during the sales cycle.Areas of expertise include, but are not limited to:
  • Data visualization
  • Data science including AI and Machine Learning
  • Additional healthcare related applications and methods such as rare disease testing, reproductive health and other genomics based clinical methods
  • Cloud based workflows and pipelines
  • Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)
  • Analysis, annotation, interpretation and reporting from NGS testing in a clinical environment
  • Oncology research & testing data analysis, management, sharing, storage and reporting
  • Consult with customers on informatics requirements (such as hardware and software required for data analysis).Typically application specific pertaining to certain Illumina products
  • Provide proof-of-concept/proof-of-principle analysis to demonstrate product fit-for-purpose
  • Partner with third party providers to provide end-to-end solutions that drive Illumina overall value in research and clinical labs
  • Work closely with other sales team members, including account managers and other sales specialists to make customers successful in clinical genomic data analysis and interpretation.Would be working particularly closely with Healthcare Account Management team.
  • Develop, coordinate and conduct both basic and advanced informatics presentations and seminars for customers.This will at times involve engaging and creative demos and some proof-of-concept work.
  • Involve other more technical or supporting roles as needed, to facilitate in-depth demos and other deeper customer assessment or pilot activities to ultimately drive sales.
  • Provide Voice of Customer input and feedback to development teams, various marketing teams and others as needed.
  • Become the sub-regional subject matter expert for Clinical Informatics, training the broader sales organization.
  • Assists customers to remove informatics barriers that may unlock sample volume, drive sequencing consumables uptake and grow the sales pipeline.This may at times involve creatively addressing customer challenges by employing Illumina professional services capabilities
  • Develop and manage active sales pipeline
  • Contribute to annual account manager strategic account management planning process.

Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive list, of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.

Position Requirements:

  • Typically 5+ years relevant experience with a bachelor's degree or 3+ years relevant experience with a master's degree. Experience in a direct sales or similar customer facing role
  • Must be willing to travel ~ 50%
  • Experience with Sequencing data analysis and interpretation (Variant Calling, filtering, annotation, interpretation and reporting)
  • Knowledge of clinical applications of sequencing, and related data formats, file types, data footprints, and typical analysis methods
  • Recognized deep technical expertise in clinical informatics, bioinformatics or an associated area
  • Experience with common software toolkits, applications, pipelines and algorithms for Next Generation Sequencing analysis, including emerging enterprise platforms
  • Knowledge of relevant cloud services and providers, including basic pricing models, etc.
  • Demonstrated written and verbal communication and training skills.
  • Outstanding problem solving and interpersonal skills.
  • Clear vision of and commitment to providing outstanding customer service
  • Ability to successfully work collaboratively in a highly matrixed sales organization

Preferred Experience/Education/Skills:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a bachelors degree, or 3 years of relevant experience with a masters degree, in Bioinformatics, Clinical data analysis, Molecular Biology, Genetics, or Biochemistry. Masters or PhD preferred

jobs.excerpt: Talent Acquisition Specialist SnapshotCurvion Blue is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and attract high-performing sales talent.
jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist Snapshot

Curvion Blue is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and attract high-performing sales talent.

This isn't a traditional HR recruiting role where you're posting jobs, waiting for applications, and hoping the right person wanders into the funnel.

You're going to be responsible for building and managing talent pipelines for sales roles across our business, with a heavy focus on identifying A-Players who can perform in high-ticket sales environments.

The ideal candidate has experience in Talent Acquisition or recruiting and understands how to source, qualify, interview, and move candidates through a high-volume hiring process.

Bonus points if you've actually sold before. Extra bonus points if you've sold high-ticket.

We want someone who understands salespeople because they've been one, worked closely with them, or recruited them extensively.

Position Overview

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will own recruiting across Curvion Blue's sales organization and help us continuously build a bench of exceptional talent.

You'll work closely with leadership to understand what "great" looks like for each role, then take that profile into the market and find the people who match it.

This is a hands-on recruiting role for someone who enjoys sourcing, talking to candidates, assessing talent, and moving quickly.

You will be responsible for the full recruiting lifecycle, including sourcing, candidate outreach, screening, interview coordination, candidate evaluation, pipeline management, and offer management.

More importantly, you'll become an expert in identifying the difference between someone who sounds like a great salesperson and someone who can actually perform.

Your Core Responsibilities

Talent Sourcing

  • Build proactive talent pipelines for closers, setters, sales leaders, and other revenue-generating roles.

  • Source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, communities, databases, and creative outbound strategies.

  • Develop targeted sourcing strategies based on role requirements and candidate profiles.

  • Continuously build talent pools rather than starting from zero every time a role opens.

Candidate Qualification

  • Conduct recruiter screens to evaluate experience, communication, motivation, sales ability, and overall fit.

  • Identify candidates with demonstrated performance rather than relying solely on resume keywords.

  • Assess candidates against defined scorecards and role-specific success profiles.

  • Understand sales metrics, quotas, KPIs, close rates, lead flow, revenue, and other performance indicators.

  • Identify red flags and know when to move a candidate forward versus cut them from the process.

Sales Talent Acquisition

  • Become deeply familiar with high-ticket sales roles and the characteristics of top-performing setters, closers, sales directors, and sales leaders.

  • Understand the difference between legitimate sales experience and resume fluff.

  • Build relationships with high-performing sales professionals and maintain a warm talent network.

  • Help Curvion Blue become known as a destination for high-performing sales talent.

Candidate Experience

  • Own candidate communication throughout the recruiting process.

  • Keep candidates engaged, informed, and moving through each stage.

  • Represent Curvion Blue professionally and enthusiastically.

  • Create a candidate experience that reflects the level of talent we want to attract.

Recruiting Operations

  • Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline stages in our ATS.

  • Track recruiting metrics including pipeline volume, conversion rates, time-to-fill, source performance, and quality of hire.

  • Coordinate interviews, skills assessments, roleplays, and other evaluation stages.

  • Partner with hiring managers to continuously improve the recruiting process.

  • Identify bottlenecks and recommend ways to improve recruiting efficiency.

Hiring & Onboarding Partnership

  • Support offer creation and candidate closing.

  • Help ensure strong candidates remain engaged through acceptance and start date.

  • Partner with the team to identify early indicators of successful hires.

  • Track quality of hire and use performance data to improve future recruiting decisions.

You SHOULD Apply If

  • You have 1+ years of Talent Acquisition, recruiting, or full-cycle recruiting experience.

  • You have experience recruiting salespeople, preferably revenue-generating roles.

  • You know how to source candidates rather than relying exclusively on inbound applicants.

  • You're comfortable conducting candidate screens and making recommendations to hiring managers.

  • You can quickly identify whether someone's experience actually matches what they're claiming.

  • You are highly comfortable talking to salespeople.

  • You understand performance-driven environments and aren't intimidated by metrics.

  • You can manage multiple open roles without losing track of candidates or details.

  • You're organized, responsive, and operationally strong.

  • You're comfortable working in an environment where priorities can move quickly.

  • You can communicate professionally with candidates at every level.

  • You're proactive. If you see a recruiting problem, your instinct is to solve it rather than wait for someone to tell you what to do.

BIG BONUS POINTS

  • You have past sales experience.

  • You have high-ticket sales experience.

  • You've been a setter, closer, AE, sales manager, or sales leader.

  • You've recruited high-ticket closers or setters before.

  • You've worked in coaching, consulting, SaaS, agency, or other performance-driven sales environments.

  • You understand sales compensation structures and can speak intelligently about earning potential with candidates.

  • You have an established network of sales talent.

  • You've recruited for remote sales organizations.

You SHOULD NOT Apply If

  • You only want to work inbound applications.

  • You don't enjoy outbound sourcing.

  • You need every step of your day mapped out for you.

  • You don't like metrics or performance accountability.

  • You're uncomfortable making judgment calls on candidates.

  • You struggle to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • You view recruiting as simply scheduling interviews and forwarding resumes.

  • You don't enjoy talking to people.

  • You're looking for a slow-moving corporate environment with six approval layers before anything gets done.

  • You have never recruited before and are looking for your first opportunity in Talent Acquisition.

Long-Term

You become one of the people Curvion Blue relies on to answer:

"We need five great salespeople. Where are they?"

And your answer is:

"Already working on it."

The Person We're Looking For

We're not looking for someone who simply wants to "work in HR."

We're looking for a talent hunter.

Someone who enjoys the chase.

Someone who can look at a LinkedIn profile and immediately start thinking:

"This person might be good. Let me find out."

You should enjoy talking to people, asking good questions, spotting potential, and figuring out what makes someone tick.

You should be competitive enough to care about winning the search, analytical enough to care about hiring quality, and organized enough to keep the machine running.

If you've sold before, you'll probably have a natural advantage here because you already understand how to build rapport, overcome objections, create urgency, and influence decisions.

If you've sold high-ticket, even better. You already understand the world our candidates operate in.

  • Audit and harden infrastructure deployments across IaC tooling including Terraform, Helm, and Ansible

  • Build and maintain tooling for vulnerability management, secret scanning, dependency auditing, and incident detection

  • Embed security review into the deployment loop: packaging, versioning, and rollback pipelines

  • Partner with Infrastructure on security requirements for Menlo Cloud without owning the infrastructure itself

What We're Looking For

  • 5 or more years as a software or security engineer with strong hands-on security depth

  • Experience defining security boundaries in distributed systems, including hybrid cloud and on-premise environments

  • Hands-on Linux systems engineering and networking experience

  • Proficiency with IaC tooling such as Terraform, Helm, or Ansible

  • Experience with Kubernetes and securing containerized environments

  • Ability to threat model novel attack surfaces, including hardware-adjacent or agent-driven software

Bonus Points

Why Join Menlo?

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.


The Role

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to support hiring across multiple functions and regions as BJAK continues to scale globally.

This is a hands-on recruitment role for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple hiring priorities, and partnering closely with stakeholders to deliver hiring outcomes. You will have exposure to a wide range of functions including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, and other business-critical teams.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for assigned roles across multiple functions and locations.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, candidate profiles, and business priorities.

  • Source, screen, assess, and engage candidates through various channels including LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, job boards, and direct outreach.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for both active and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping and market research to support hiring strategies.

  • Coordinate and manage interview processes while ensuring a positive candidate experience.

  • Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment activities within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

  • Provide regular hiring updates and pipeline insights to hiring managers and stakeholders.

  • Support recruitment process improvements, hiring initiatives, and employer branding activities where required.

  • Collaborate with recruiters, coordinators, and business leaders to achieve hiring goals across the organization.


The Right Fit Has

  • 2–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, Executive Search, Staffing, or a related field.

  • Proven experience managing multiple vacancies simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong sourcing capabilities across LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, networking, and direct outreach.

  • Experience recruiting across multiple functions such as Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, or other corporate functions.

  • Strong candidate assessment and interviewing skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and execution.

  • Comfortable operating in an environment with evolving priorities and ambitious hiring goals.

  • Demonstrates ownership, resilience, adaptability, and a proactive mindset.

  • Experience in technology companies, startups, recruitment agencies, or high-growth organizations is highly preferred.

  • Fluency in English is required. Additional language capabilities such as Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, or Japanese are an advantage.


What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers strong candidate pipelines across multiple functions and markets.

  • Consistently achieves hiring targets while maintaining quality and candidate experience.

  • Builds trusted relationships with hiring managers and stakeholders.

  • Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability throughout the recruitment process.

  • Contributes to improving recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and overall team performance.


Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and development opportunities.

  • Exposure to international hiring across multiple markets and functions.

  • Opportunity to work directly with experienced recruiters and business leaders.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and responsibility from day one.

  • Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.

  • Meaningful work that directly contributes to the growth and success of the business.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Your work will span both sales-led and product-led motions and help Dropbox tell a sharper, more differentiated story.

Our client is a fast-growing AI infrastructure company that has built a state-of-the-art data curation platform used to train some of the most demanding deep learning models in the world. Their technology automatically curates and optimizes petabytes of training data — algorithms that are modality-agnostic and require no labels — to make model training dramatically faster and more efficient. Customers see results that speak for themselves: 7x–40x faster training, model performance equivalent to training on 10x more raw data, and smaller models (with less than half the parameters) that outperform larger ones and substantially cut deployment costs.

The Mission

Foundational models are only as good as the data they're trained on. Our client exists to close the gap between raw data and truly optimized training data — without requiring labels, without adding compute cost, and without forcing customers to compromise on model quality. Every strategic account this team lands is a chance to prove that better data curation, not just bigger models, is the unlock the industry has been missing.

The Opportunity

As Forward Deployed Engineer (Post-Sales), this is a rare role at a company small enough that your fingerprints will be on every major account, and well-funded enough that the roadmap, the compensation, and the customer roster are all already real. jobs.description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable -- turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role

As an Electrical Engineer, you will own the design, integration, and bring-up of the electronic systems that power Asimov. From power distribution to motor control to sensor integration, you will work across schematics, PCB layouts, harness design, and hardware debug -- ensuring every electrical decision holds up in the field and integrates cleanly with the broader mechanical and firmware stack.

What You'll Do

  • Design and review schematics and PCB layouts for power distribution units, motor driver boards, and actuator control electronics

  • Integrate wiring harnesses, PCBA enclosures, and motor controllers into mechanical assemblies from the ground up

  • Lead bring-up of power systems, sensors, and actuator subassemblies; diagnose and resolve issues across multiple hardware revisions

  • Define and run electrical and system-level test protocols, analyze failure modes, and iterate based on test data

  • Work closely with firmware and controls teams to ensure electrical design choices support stable, low-latency control loops

  • Apply expertise in connector selection, grounding strategies, harness routing, and EMI suppression to ensure robust and field-reliable hardware

  • Contribute to Menlo's open-source design efforts, including PCB schematics and manufacturing documentation for the broader robotics community

What You'll Bring

  • 3 or more years of hands-on electrical engineering experience on high-complexity electromechanical products

  • Solid understanding of electrical and electronic systems, including motor drivers, sensors, and embedded hardware integration

  • Deep familiarity with low-voltage (under 60V) DC power systems, DC-DC converters, MOSFET gate drivers, current-sense amplifiers, and passive network design

  • Proficiency using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and CAN/UART sniffers for in-depth hardware debug

  • Expertise in connector selection, grounding strategies, harness routing, and EMI suppression techniques

  • Strong communication skills to drive alignment across firmware teams, mechanical engineers, and leadership

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with bipedal or humanoid robot hardware or legged locomotion platforms

  • Familiarity with CAN bus, motor controllers, and how electrical design choices affect firmware and control integration

  • Scripting experience in Python for hardware automation and data analysis

  • Familiarity with sim-to-real workflows and how hardware decisions affect locomotion policy training and transfer

Why Join Menlo?

You will be part of a tight-knit team defining the next generation of humanoid robots. With genuine ownership of the mechanical systems that bring Asimov to life, you will see your designs go from CAD to real-world deployments. If you thrive in fast-paced, open-collaborative environments, let's build the future of robotics together.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

The Senior Consultant, Data Services is a critical, client-facing role that supports the design, development, testing, and delivery of sophisticated data integration, modeling, and analytics solutions for Nordic clients. Operating at the intersection of technology, strategy, and healthcare operations, this position plays a key role in advancing data-driven transformation within complex healthcare environments.

As a senior member of the Data Services team, this individual serves as both a technical expert and trusted advisor, translating business needs into actionable insights, aligning analytics capabilities with client goals, and delivering high-impact solutions that drive measurable outcomes. In addition to hands-on solution development, the Senior Consultant provides strategic guidance, mentorship to junior team members, and thought leadership across Nordic’s analytics initiatives.

This role is a direct extension of Nordic’s commitment to excellence and innovation in healthcare. Senior Consultants are expected to embody Nordic’s core values, build trusted relationships with clients and colleagues, and consistently demonstrate professionalism, and integrity. As a visible representative of Nordic, this role can shape client success, influence enterprise analytics strategies, and contribute to the continued growth and leadership of Nordic in the healthcare data and analytics space.

The ideal candidate is a highly motivated, technically skilled, and client-centered professional with deep experience in healthcare data ecosystems, a passion for solving complex problems, and the ability to lead and collaborate across multi-disciplinary teams. This role focuses on high-impact projects that improve business processes, enhance clinical operations, and elevate the strategic use of data across healthcare organizations.

Key Responsibilities

As a strategic contributor and visible representative of Nordic’s Data & Analytics practice, the Senior Consultant, Data Services will assume a variety of responsibilities, including but not limited to:

Client Delivery & Strategic Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to healthcare clients, translating complex business questions into impactful data and analytics solutions
  • Support end-to-end delivery of analytics projects, gathering requirements, architecting solutions, and overseeing development, testing, deployment, and adoption
  • Collaborate directly with client stakeholders across clinical, operational, and executive teams to align analytics efforts with strategic priorities
  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance analytics maturity, optimize processes, and increase the business value of data assets
  • Represent Nordic with professionalism and integrity in all client engagements, ensuring exceptional service, strategic insight, and consistent alignment with Nordic’s values
  • Guide project teams and support solution governance by providing input into architecture, data modeling, data pipelines, and reporting design decisions
  • Assist with the development of dashboards, reports, and data models based on client requirements
  • Support data integration and transformation activities across multiple healthcare data types (e.g., claims, EHR, operational data)
  • Conduct data validation and quality assurance activities to ensure accuracy and reliability of outputs
  • Participate in client meetings, requirements gathering sessions, and presentation reviews
  • Fulfill ad hoc data and reporting requests independently or with guidance from senior staff
  • Contribute to project documentation, testing, and user support efforts

Technical Execution & Innovation

  • Design and build robust, scalable data models and analytics products using industry-leading BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and Qlik

  • Contribute to performance testing, documentation, upgrades, and validation strategies across multiple client systems and environments
  • Stay current on emerging technologies and analytics trends in healthcare and identify opportunities to pilot innovative approaches

Team Collaboration and Internal Growth

  • Mentor and support junior team members, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing, learning, and professional growth
  • Assist leadership in project estimation, resource planning, and task coordination to ensure smooth delivery execution
  • Contribute to the development of reusable tools, solution accelerators, and best practice documentation that improve team efficiency and delivery consistency
  • Support Nordic’s internal strategic initiatives, participate in team training sessions, and help evolve the Data Services practice through process improvement and thought leadership
  • Model Nordic’s core maxims and values by promoting collaboration, excellence, and customer-first thinking across teams and engagements

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, healthcare administration, information systems, or related field; advanced degree preferred
  • Minimum 8+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, data engineering, or business intelligence, with demonstrated success in client-facing or consulting roles
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience specifically in data analysis, reporting, or BI development within healthcare environments

Skills and Experience
